items.prompt: Why are put-call parity and broad price bounds insufficient as the only tests here?
items.modelAnswer: Parity can be imposed by construction and bounds are broad; both can pass with wrong units/inputs or shared formula errors. Need independent numerical expectation/reference, limits/domain and model/contract tests; passing formula tests does not establish calibration or execution.
